permanentlyTrueByDesign.note: These two conditions were listed under blockedOn while a generated distribution repository and its release bot were still expected. Cratis/AI#266 retired generated distribution in full, so neither can ever resolve and neither gates legacy retirement any more. They are recorded here as permanent facts rather than as pending work.

conditions.reason: Cratis/AI is installed directly from its default branch through four committed marketplace manifests. There is no second write target, no release branch, no dist/vX.Y.Z tag namespace, and no generated tree. Cratis/AI.Distribution remains an INITIALIZED_PROTECTED_FIXTURE that no workflow writes to.

The cross-repository App tracked by Cratis/Workflows#72 and its AI_DISTRIBUTION_APP_ID and AI_DISTRIBUTION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY secrets were removed with the generated-distribution pipeline. No remaining workflow references them, so no release bot identity will be created.

blockedOnEvidence.NO_PRODUCTION_CANARY: canary.productionTargetsEnabled is false and canary.enabledTargets holds only local-fixture-simulator.
blockedOnEvidence.NO_PRODUCTION_ROLLBACK_EVIDENCE: The only rollback evidence is the local fixture simulation in distribution/evidence/local-canary-rollback-2026-08-22.json.
blockedOnEvidence.NO_APPROVED_PUBLIC_TARGETS: distribution/release-approvals.json carries defaultPolicy deny with an empty targetApprovals array.
blockedOnEvidence.PROPAGATION_FREEZE_REMAINS_ACTIVE: Legacy all-to-all propagation stays retired and repository-local legacy adapters stay in place until reviewed retirement evidence exists; see .ai/rules/managing-ai-rules.md.
